title: The Night of the Porcelain Meteors
description: Once each autumn, porcelain falls into the village kiln. By morning, the potters have a bowlful of blue flowers to set into their winter cups.
alt: A potter holds a bowl of blue-and-white shards as more porcelain arcs out of the night sky toward a glowing brick kiln.
pairing: Autumn kiln festival × porcelain meteor shower
